locomotionFeasibility.feasibility: Continuity bound max(.10,2.5d+.002)/frame at 30 Hz caps hoof speed ~max(3,2.5v); a minimum-jerk swing with walk duty >=0.5 needs 1.875v/(1-duty) so walking support and unchanged continuity are jointly infeasible without a lower-peak profile. algorithm: Per-frame reach-feasible stance: stride limited by reach disc at the 0.09 drop cap; torso drop floor from planted anchors, clamped to [0,0.09] (violations counted, never unbounded)

Earliest-deadline-first lift schedule: deadline = time until an anchor leaves the hard reach disc under forecast body motion (turn law, heading rate, eased acceleration) minus escape time; support slots per gait; rhythm lifts only when a release-aware feasibility check holds; same-frame landings count as support

Touchdown = predicted hip rest projection at whole-frame-quantised touchdown time plus centred forward lead; 3D path check along the swing; duration extended (<=0.45 s) instead of truncating span; velocity-continuous re-aim in flight
Turn rate limited per frame from per-leg and summed swing budgets (0.5-3 rad/s)
Stop: reachable touchdowns kept, otherwise land promptly at nearest reachable point; stationary recovery steps one hoof at a time (>=3 support); torso rises only as anchors allow
Teleport: existing reset plus drop reset

rootCauses: Swing time had no lift-to-touchdown budget: replans restarted the clock, the continuity re-time granted a fresh SWING_MAX, frame jitter overran by up to one frame

A touchdown at the rear edge of planning reach was accepted; the hoof then had to lift at once and the gait profile lift-off ramp lagged the accelerating hip beyond true reach (the 2.858 mm case); re-aims were capped at 3 per swing and refused in the last 10% of travel

Support schedule: early-landing requests were blocked by the replan cap or were infeasible inside the continuity envelope; swing extensions (safety re-aims, continuity re-times) ignored which touchdowns support depended on; hooves about to land were not in the earliest-deadline schedule
An idle request while the root still coasts above 1.7 m/s was stepped as a trot but labelled idle; planner did not apply the documented gait hand-over rule
fixes: Swing budget: every swing touches down within SWING_MAX of lift-off, one recent longest frame in reserve

Touchdown safety: a landing whose stance would end before the hoof could escape is re-aimed; velocity-continuous re-aims have no count cap; reaimSwing (opt-in gait profile only) now refuses only in the last 1% of travel (was 10%): the post-re-aim hoof speed is remaining distance / remaining time x a bounded factor (<=3)

Support-aware timing: a touchdown is never delayed past what the support schedule can absorb (feasibility check incl. swinging hooves next lifts) or when fewer hooves are down than the gait floor; continuity re-times always get the frames the envelope needs (existing hard threshold) and further only as support allows

Every re-aim is checked frame by frame against the continuity envelope at the longest recent frame time; an early landing that cannot fit keeps or re-times its current landing; the schedule picks the slot that can be brought forward soonest
Coasting idle above 1.7 m/s is reported as trot (as walk mode already was); planner applies the hand-over rule to late lifts
